Estimating from the photo, the plate holds about 6-7 pineapple pieces and about 10 watermelon chunks.

Pineapple: roughly 7 pieces at about 12 g each is about 85 g. At 50 kcal per 100 g, that is about 42 kcal.

Watermelon: roughly 11 pieces at about 12 g each is about 130 g. At 30 kcal per 100 g, that is about 39 kcal.

Together that is about 215 g of food and about 81 kcal. I'm rounding down slightly to allow for the pieces being small.
